capabilities: Lay out character sheets on a grid
Apply typed modifiers with source breakdowns
Store characters as plain Markdown notes
Import and export layouts to share
disambiguation: Not a spreadsheet plugin; it builds interactive character sheets for tabletop RPGs.
extras: The plugin rewrites note bodies and the author advises trying it in a new vault first. Layouts are stored as .sheetsmith JSON files that stay hidden unless Detect all file extensions is enabled. It makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build interactive, formula-driven character sheets for arbitrary tabletop RPG systems.
summary: Grid-based character sheet builder for tabletop RPGs that keeps each character as a plain Markdown note with custom formulas.
